tool_signatures.name: createRoadbookFromPlaces
tool_signatures.description: Builds an OpenVan roadbook — the same trip plan people make in the roadbook wizard — from 2-10 place names: route, day-by-day plan with overnights, budget (fuel, tolls, vignettes, ferries), and per country the entry and vehicle rules for the given passports and plates, holidays, safety, power and customs. Identical requests return the same roadbook. The route is built in the background: poll GET /api/roadbook/{code}/status until status is ready, then open `url` (a shareable page the traveller can edit).

tool_signatures.name: getActiveFires
tool_signatures.description: NASA FIRMS VIIRS satellite fire detections (NOAA-20, Suomi NPP) for the last 48 hours, low-confidence points excluded. `frp` is fire radiative power in MW: single digits — a small fire or a flare, tens and hundreds — a real wildfire. Box up to 10°×10°. Rate limit 30 requests/minute.

tool_signatures.name: getCustomsRules
tool_signatures.description: Rules of the country and its bloc: banned goods, cash declaration, alcohol, tobacco, goods value, fuel in a canister. Each item carries a verbatim quote of the official source, its URL and the check date. With `from`, rules account for where you come from: no customs inside the EU, and the EU meat and dairy ban does not apply to travellers from Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Andorra, San Marino and Liechtenstein. A country without data returns 404 with `covered=false` — that means no data, not "nothing is restricted".

tool_signatures.name: getHolidayCountries
tool_signatures.description: Coverage by country and kind: `public` — public holidays (Nager.Date, 200+ countries), `school` — school holidays by region (OpenHolidays API, ~30 countries), `traffic` — official peak traffic forecast days (France, Bison Futé).

tool_signatures.name: getHolidays
tool_signatures.description: Public holidays, school holidays and peak traffic days in date order. School holidays are often regional: `nationwide=false` and `regions` lists ISO 3166-2 codes. For `traffic`, `details` holds the day colour for departures and returns (green, orange, red, black). A country without data returns 404 with `covered=false` — that means no data, not "no holidays".
